name: Sekret ideal'noyi novely
source:
Have you ever wondered the secret to a successful visual novel? This is the eternal question of every author, but has anyone managed to answer it? Jami, an inquisitive scout, is ready to take apart every piece of existing works to reveal all the secrets of success. What to write? How to do it? How many cats to add? Wait, what are the cats for? Join Jami and her unexpected sidekick on an incredible investigation to find out!

[Translated from [url=https://plyih.itch.io/secretofperfectvisualnovel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是否想过视觉小说成功的秘诀？这是每个作者永恒的问题，但有人能回答这个问题吗？贾米是一位好奇的侦察员，他准备拆开现有的每一件作品，以揭示所有成功的秘密。写什么？怎么做呢？要添加多少只猫？等等，这些猫是用来做什么的？与贾米和她意想不到的伙伴一起进行令人难以置信的调查来找出答案！

[译自[url=https://plyih.itch.io/secretofperfectvisualnovel]itch.io[/url]]
